blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — As the country braces for the Super El Niño projected to peak at the end of 2026 and persist until the first half of 2027, the Valencia City Water District (VCWD) here has stepped up proactive measures to protect water security across 17 of the city’s 31 villages. Michael Pornia, VCWD administration and general services manager, told the Inquirer on Tuesday that the district currently relies on deep wells for 91 percent of its operations, serving over 27,000 connections without any production slowdowns reported thus far.
